text: We map the full path a POS file takes from the file share to a queryable row in Snowflake -- two very different legs, each with its own trigger.

An on-prem file share has no native push event, so a Self-Hosted Integration Runtime lets pl_copy_pos_exports reach it on a tight 5-minute schedule. The Blob-to-Snowflake leg is genuinely event-driven.
An Azure Event Grid notification tells Snowpipe the instant a file lands in Blob storage -- auto-ingest starts within about a minute, with nothing polling on a clock.
Adding up every honest hop -- the schedule interval, Snowpipe's ingest latency, the Stream-and-Task merge -- gives a worst-case target under 10 minutes, against a report that's two days late today.
Next: turning every plan from these three lessons into real Terraform infrastructure.
